events.title: Arctic Roll Runs Great on Steam Deck!
events.summary: Hello explorers!Steam Deck testing is complete, and Arctic Roll is running smoothly! You can enjoy your Arctic adventure on the go using the Windows version through Proton.The game has not yet received an official Steam Deck Verified rating from Valve, but our own testing has been successful.Grab your gear, gather your team, and brave the cold wherever you are!

events.title: The Arctic Roll Demo Is Out Now!
events.summary: Start your expedition today in Arctic Roll, a chill turn-based tactical roguelite about exploration, survival, and strange discoveries.Lead your team, manage your supplies, collect golden nuggets, uncover artifacts, and push deeper into the frozen unknown through procedurally generated levels.The demo runs great on Steam Deck and can also be played using the touchscreen, giving you a smooth and comfortable way to play on the go.Download the demo now!

events.title: Why Arctic Roll
events.summary: As a Canadian, I’ve always felt a deep connection to the North. The vast landscapes, the silence, and the slow rhythm of life inspired me to create Arctic Roll. This game is my way of bringing that feeling to players everywhere.Arctic Roll is not about rushing. It’s a chill, relaxing experience designed for those who want to take their time, breathe, and enjoy the journey.
